visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs sits on a tatami mat in a room with a grey curtain. She is wearing a white t-shirt and grey overalls. She shields her eyes with her right hand, looking squinted and distressed as if from bright sunlight. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot where she applies white sunscreen from a white tube onto her left arm, rubbing it in thoroughly. (3) She puts on a beige bucket hat and dons a light pink long-sleeved jacket over her overalls. She looks determined. (4) She displays a pack of cooling wipes and a small pink handheld fan to the camera. Finally, she opens a black umbrella with a light blue interior. (5) There is a quick glitch-effect transition showing her with all her gear. (6) Sudden cut to an outdoor scene in heavy rain. The ground is wet, and several distant figures are visible walking with umbrellas in what appears to be a park or cultural site with trees and a rope fence. (7) The woman stands outdoors in the heavy rain, holding her black and blue umbrella. She looks up at the sky and then directly at the camera with a surprised and disappointed facial expression. She is wearing all the sun-protection gear she prepared earlier.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous 'expectations vs. reality' scenario where the creator meticulously prepares for a hot sunny day with various sun-protection gear, only to be met with an intense rainstorm once outside.
